title: Intercompany service arrangements: recharge analysis
prompt: Review intercompany service arrangements and actual costs. Map the transaction flows and prepare a preliminary recharge accounting analysis.

inputs.name: Actual costs by entity and cost centre for the quarter

steps: read each service agreement: provider, recipient, services, cost base, allocation key, markup, billing frequency; read the standing allocation workbook
pull the intercompany relationships, the balances matrix and the quarter's actual costs by entity
map the flows (who provides what to whom) and compute the recharge each agreement implies from actual costs; compare with what was booked
draft the entries each entity would need inside the memo only; nothing is proposed in Dime
write the memo citing the agreement clauses and the guidance relied on (marked "verify") and the workbook of flows, computed recharges and booked amounts

done.text: The memo cites the paragraphs it relies on, marks every citation "verify", draws no conclusion where facts are missing, and leaves the judgement with the accountant; it uses none of the words definitely, certainly or guaranteed
The memo exists as a pdf
Every exception row (a flow without an agreement, a recharge differing from what was booked) cites the agreement clause and the entity and account ids
intercompany-recharge.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Draft entries appear in the memo only and are never proposed; computed recharges show their arithmetic from actual costs and the allocation key
